## Source: amazon-inspector (bed3c7b9b467652f58bd7ff55383900d1e7fbe73c1acbce4c79e12040b96ce9f)
Analysis of brambletask 0.1.0 on PyPI surfaced no indicators of supply-chain attack behavior. No install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or filesystem harvesting, no fetch-and-execute of remote content, and no persistence or backdoor mechanisms were observed in the package's shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (922435cd67a39583e0143229da6822f691940fcea9f4b4b18203faa594a1debc)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
